segments.sn41.5:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā kāmabhū macchikāsaṇḍe viharati ambāṭakavane.
segments.sn41.5:1.2: Atha kho citto gahapati yenāyasmā kāmabhū tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ kāmabhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho cittaṃ gahapatiṃ āyasmā kāmabhū etadavoca –
segments.sn41.5:3.3: Anīghaṃ passa āyantaṃ [appattaṃ (syā. kaṃ. ka.)], chinnasotaṃ abandhanan”ti.
segments.sn41.5:4.1: “Imassa nu kho, gahapati, saṃkhittena bhāsitassa kathaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo”ti?
segments.sn41.5:4.2: “Kiṃ nu kho etaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā bhāsitan”ti?
segments.sn41.5:4.4: “Tena hi, bhante, muhuttaṃ āgamehi yāvassa atthaṃ pekkhāmī”ti.
segments.sn41.5:4.5: Atha kho citto gahapati muhuttaṃ tuṇhī hutvā āyasmantaṃ kāmabhuṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn41.5:5.5: ‘Ratho’ti kho, bhante, imassetaṃ cātumahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummāsūpacayassa aniccucchādanaparimaddanabhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammassa.
segments.sn41.5:5.6: Rāgo kho, bhante, nīgho, doso nīgho, moho nīgho.
segments.sn41.5:5.7: Te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṅkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
segments.sn41.5:5.11: Sā khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṅkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
segments.sn41.5:5.13: Rāgo kho, bhante, bandhanaṃ, doso bandhanaṃ, moho bandhanaṃ.
segments.sn41.5:5.14: Te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṅkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
segments.sn41.5:5.16: Iti kho, bhante, yaṃ taṃ bhagavatā vuttaṃ –
segments.sn41.5:7.1: “Imassa kho, bhante, bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmī”ti.
segments.sn41.5:7.3: Yassa te gambhīre buddhavacane paññācakkhu kamatī”ti.

lines: Muhuttaṃ tuṇhī hutvāti tassa atthapekkhanatthaṃ tīṇi piṭakāni kaṇṇe kuṇḍalaṃ viya sañcālento “ayaṃ imassa attho, ayaṃ imassa attho”ti upaparikkhaṇatthaṃ muhuttaṃ tuṇhī hutvā.
Imaṃ pana pañhaṃ kathento upāsako dukkaraṃ akāsi.
Sammāsambuddho hi “passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, etaṃ bhikkhuṃ āgacchantaṃ odātakaṃ tanukaṃ tuṅganāsikan”ti (saṃ. ni.2.245) attano diṭṭhena kathesi.
Ayaṃ pana nayaggāhena “arahato etaṃ adhivacanan”ti āha.
Elaṃ vuccati doso, taṃ etassa natthīti nelaṃ, taṃ aṅgaṃ etassāti nelaṅgo, suvisuddhasīlaguṇo.
Aṭṭhakathāyaṃ pana dosābhāvameva dassetuṃ “nelaṅgoti niddoso”ti vuttaṃ.
Attano diṭṭhena kathesīti attano sabbaññutaññāṇena paccakkhato upalakkhitena atthena kathesi.
Ayaṃ pana nayaggāhenāti ayaṃ pana gahapati asutvā kevalaṃ nayaggāhena āha.
